sources.notes: First comprehensive history of early Christianity from apostolic era to Constantine. Eusebius was eyewitness to Diocletian persecution. Books VI-VIII cover 3rd century extensively.

sources.work: Collected Works (De Principiis, Contra Celsum, Hexapla, Commentaries)
sources.notes: Most important theologian before Augustine. His works reveal intellectual climate of 3rd century Alexandria and response to pagan critics.
81 surviving letters documenting Decian persecution, lapsi controversy, episcopal authority, and sacramental theology. Contemporary primary source.
Theological treatise on Christians who apostatized during Decian persecution. Advocates moderate position of readmission after penance.
Actual surviving certificates issued to those who sacrificed during Decian persecution. Direct archaeological evidence.
Authentic judicial records of Cyprian's trial and execution. One of the most reliable martyrdom documents.
First Christian biography written by someone who knew the subject personally. Pontius was Cyprian's deacon.
Foundational hagiography of Christian monasticism. Athanasius knew Antony personally. Became bestseller of 4th century, inspiring Augustine's conversion.

sources.work: De Mortibus Persecutorum (On the Deaths of the Persecutors)
sources.notes: Polemical history of persecutors from Nero to Galerius. Detailed account of Diocletian persecution. Written by Christian apologist who witnessed events.

sources.work: Acta Martyrum (Acts of the Martyrs, 3rd century collection)
sources.notes: Collection of martyrdom accounts from Decian, Valerian, and Diocletian persecutions. Variable reliability; some authentic judicial records, others hagiographical.

sources.work: Vita Pauli (Life of Paul the Hermit)
sources.notes: Biography of Paul of Thebes, allegedly the first hermit. Jerome also wrote extensively on desert monasticism and knew Egyptian monks.
Collection of biographies of Egyptian and Palestinian monks. Palladius visited Egyptian desert and interviewed monks. Important source for early monasticism.

sources.work: Origen: The Bible and Philosophy in the Third-Century Church
sources.notes: Comprehensive modern biography of Origen integrating historical context, theology, and intellectual milieu of 3rd century Alexandria.

sources.work: Martyrdom and Persecution in the Early Church
sources.notes: Standard scholarly work on Christian persecution from Jesus to Constantine. Comprehensive analysis of Decian and Diocletian persecutions.
